source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES selects Manufacturer/ProductName/AssetTag from an assumed URI but does not prove CPU-sled identity, define AssetTag semantics or perform the specified IPMI/UI/reference parity.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED identifies AssetTag as distinct from serial and requires complete mapped cross-source evidence.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 954/2291 accepts direct execution without resolving sled membership or the meaning of AssetTag.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: CEMR is a module FRU; FE_1~4 are front-end FRUs. Their asset labels cannot establish the CPU sled record.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 preserves WebUI/IPMI scope, ED-34 controls alternate inventory paths, ED-35 retains full parity and ED-36 makes sled map/reference normal readiness.

original_test_intent: Validate that FRU_CPUSLED belongs to the intended CPU sled and that complete FRU identity—including the project-defined AssetTag rather than an assumed serial alias—is consistent in WebUI, Redfish, IPMI and the approved asset record.
original_method: Map the physical CPU sled to exact Redfish and IPMI FRU objects, collect their full read-only outputs and the WebUI page, normalize all fields while keeping AssetTag and SerialNumber separate, then compare against the Project inventory without clearing logs or writing FRU data.
manual_activity: The asset owner supplies the exact sled/member/device mapping and AssetTag authority. Collection is automatable; an operator validates UI presentation and the engineer resolves asset-record discrepancies.
safety_requirements: Use read-only retrieval only; prohibit FRU edit, BMC reset and host reboot.
Do not equate AssetTag, serial, UUID or service tag without an approved mapping.
Discover the sled member/device instead of trusting a friendly resource name.
Protect credentials and redact asset/serial identifiers while retaining stable correlation.
Stop on ambiguous sled, duplicated AssetTag or unresolved source disagreement; do not retry another FRU by guess.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve one CPU sled across physical, Redfish, IPMI and WebUI identities.
Collect complete redacted structured and IPMI FRU evidence with timestamps.
Normalize fields with distinct AssetTag/SerialNumber columns.
Compare to the Project asset/FRU record and report missing/stale/mismatch outcomes.
engineer_actions: Approve sled mapping and AssetTag authority/format.
Approve complete field set, normalization and redaction.
Review exceptions and assign formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The three-field GET is only partial: it assumes the member, weakens TLS and omits IPMI/UI parity and AssetTag interpretation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve the CPU sled, collect full protected Redfish and exact read-only IPMI FRU data, keep AssetTag distinct, and compare all approved fields plus WebUI.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_CPUSLED, WebUI and ipmitool comparison, readable/correct Criterion and original time values are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use exact-sled multi-source FRU parity with AssetTag-aware normalization.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, schema, IPMI and asset-database revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor CPU-sled FRU layout and Project asset inventory.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic target mapping, full fields, AssetTag semantics and secure redacted evidence while retaining original interfaces.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Three Redfish properties cannot prove IPMI/UI parity or complete sled identity.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Sled map, FRU layout, AssetTag rule and reference.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: AssetTag may be blank, mutable or administratively assigned and must not be substituted for immutable serial identity.

project_override_considerations: Another asset/FRU collector is acceptable only when exact CPU-sled binding, approval, field equivalence and uncovered WebUI/IPMI scope are recorded.
expected_evidence: CPU sled and BMC identity with exact API/IPMI mapping
Complete raw redacted Redfish and IPMI FRU outputs
WebUI capture and Project asset/FRU reference
AssetTag-aware normalized comparison separate from serial
Uncleared logs, no-write proof and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master fields consistently target CPU-sled FRU correctness and IPMI comparison; prior command incompleteness is not a source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The sled inventory purpose is clear. Mapping and AssetTag expectations are normal readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Restores full parity and corrects unsafe AssetTag/target assumptions.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with the hybrid classification and AssetTag-specific safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds target and semantic gates before execution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Separates CPU sled evidence from CEM and front-end FRUs.

review_improvement: Prevents AssetTag from being treated as an immutable serial and makes the physical CPU-sled linkage auditable across every inventory surface.
independent_technical_reasoning: AssetTag is commonly administrative and can be empty or duplicated, while serial and FRU device location identify hardware. Therefore a correct AssetTag value alone cannot prove the intended sled; the evidence must first bind the physical sled and then compare AssetTag under the Project's explicit rules.
